parameters.jsCode: const claim=$json; const intent=$('Validate and prepare pitch').first().json; if(claim.disposition!=='claimed') return []; if(!claim.claim_token) throw new Error('Missing claim token'); const route=intent.route; if(route){ const u=new URL(String(route.url||'')); if(u.protocol!=='https:'||route.verified!==true||route.free!==true||route.method!=='POST'||route.requires_login===true||route.requires_captcha===true) throw new Error('Form route is not eligible for unattended execution'); const vars={artist:'VIRYA',email:$env.VIRYA_OUTREACH_FROM_EMAIL||'',pitch_title:intent.pitch_title,pitch_url:intent.pitch_url,epk_url:intent.epk_url,message:intent.body}; const resolve=v=>String(v).replace(/\{\{(artist|email|pitch_title|pitch_url|epk_url|message)\}\}/g,(_,k)=>vars[k]??''); const fields=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(route.fields||{}).map(([k,v])=>[k,resolve(v)])); const ct=route.content_type==='application/x-www-form-urlencoded'?'application/x-www-form-urlencoded':'application/json'; const raw=ct==='application/x-www-form-urlencoded'?new URLSearchParams(fields).toString():JSON.stringify(fields); return [{json:{...intent,claim_token:claim.claim_token,delivery_mode:'form',form_url:u.toString(),form_content_type:ct,form_body:raw}}]; } if(!intent.contact_email) throw new Error('No verified email and no eligible form route'); return [{json:{...intent,claim_token:claim.claim_token,delivery_mode:'email'}}];

const intent=$('Choose verified delivery route').first().json; const failed=Boolean($json.error); return [{json:{action_id:intent.action_id,receipt_key:`outreach:${intent.action_id}:form:${intent.phase}`,executor_id:$env.VIRYA_N8N_EXECUTOR_ID,status:failed?'failed':'succeeded',claim_token:intent.claim_token,provider_reference:intent.form_url,error_kind:failed?'form_submit_failed':null,metadata:{channel:'form',destination:intent.form_url},occurred_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];
